post.description:
Register a campaign: a checkout where it is, a repository that the daemon clones under its home first, or a fork.

Each registration of a URL clones it again, into a directory named after the new campaign's id. A fork clones the
checkout of its source, a campaign in any state, and starts from a version of it: by default its head.

It adds the campaign with its head version as the baseline candidate, and syncs its documents into its memory. The
daemon then measures the baseline: its ``measurement.recorded`` event comes after the answer's cursor, and a
baseline that fails pauses the campaign. A clone that does not register is deleted.

Read the campaign's ``piloop.toml`` again, and sync its documents into its memory.

A changed evaluate command, metric set or link makes a new evaluator. A stopped campaign whose stop conditions
changed is active again.

post.description:
Queue a message for the next turn of a running agent: a note on it, which the daemon delivers.

With wait, it answers once something came of the note, or at the end of the wait with ``pending``. The note is
written first, in the thread pool; between two reads of its outcome the route holds no thread.

Cancel an agent of any role: a requested one never starts, a running one ends as ``ending`` says.

For an implementer, this cancels its run. The daemon acts at once.
Acknowledge inbox items, to say that the caller has seen them. Nothing waits for an acknowledgement.
Answer an inbox item with a ``decision`` on the root of its thread, which is an inbox item of its own.
Add a defined idea, which the daemon schedules in priority order once it is ready.

nodes.title: Nodes
nodes.description: Each parent before its children, such as oldest first.

spine.title: Spine

series.title: Series

A campaign as its provider sees it: the vocabulary, the nodes, the spine and its steps.

It is checked when it is made: every name refers to an entry, every parent comes before its child, and the spine
and the series are paths of the graph. A graph that breaks a rule is a provider's bug.

IdeaAnswer.description: An idea that a change wrote, read at ``cursor``.

hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

provenance.title: Provenance

family.title: Family

proposed.title: Proposed

track.title: Track

supersedes.title: Supersedes

IdeaStatus.title: IdeaStatus
IdeaStatus.description:

A ``seed`` is a rough idea with pointers. An agent whose role's ``files`` allows it files one (``piloop idea
seed``). Research develops it into a defined idea (``piloop idea develop``, which makes it ``ready`` or
``proposed``), or rejects it.
A ``proposed`` idea is defined and waits for a human to approve it.

version.title: Version

harness.title: Harness

in_reply_to.title: In Reply To

label.description: How a legend names it, such as ``Baseline``.

NodeKind.title: NodeKind
NodeKind.description: What a node is, in the provider's words.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a node's ``status`` says, such as ``kept``.

label.title: Label
label.description: How a legend names it, such as ``Kept``.

NodeStatus.title: NodeStatus
NodeStatus.description: Where a node is, in the provider's words.

follow_ups.title: Follow Ups
follow_ups.description: A seed pinned to the candidate for each, for research to develop.

track.title: Track
track.description: The track of the follow-ups. Default: the track of the candidate's run, else the first track.

NoteBody.title: NoteBody
NoteBody.description: Why a regressed result is worth starting from, and the seeds to pin to it.

seeds.title: Seeds
seeds.description: The follow-ups: seeds pinned to the candidate.

Noted.title: Noted
Noted.description: A regressed candidate kept in view as a lead.

OpenRun.title: OpenRun
OpenRun.description: A run that is queued or running.

Outcome.title: Outcome
Outcome.description: A verdict: what a rule gives, and what ``candidates.verdict`` holds. The column is NULL until a candidate is judged.

Overview.title: Overview
Overview.description: What ``piloop status`` prints: the daemon, the live keys that ``config.toml`` or a limit sets, and each overview.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, with ids: what the pause waits for.

evals.title: Evals
evals.description: Hold the measurements that the daemon starts too: after a new evaluator, or asked.

Pending.title: Pending
Pending.description: Nothing came of the note yet: the daemon queues it once the agent runs.

error.title: Error
error.description: A ``Problem``. Missing from a 404 of a route that the daemon does not have: it runs an older piloop.

ProblemDetail.title: ProblemDetail
ProblemDetail.description: Why a route refuses a request, with its status: a ``Problem``, and what to do.

wait.title: Wait
wait.description: Seconds to hold the request while there is nothing to answer yet.

PromptBody.title: PromptBody
PromptBody.description: A message for the next turn of a running agent. With wait, the answer waits for what came of it.

Prompted.title: Prompted
Prompted.description: A note on an agent, which the daemon delivers, and what came of it, read at ``cursor``.

Queued.title: Queued
Queued.description: The agent's runtime holds the note: the agent reads it at its next turn.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The name of the candidate's campaign.

Reasoned.title: Reasoned
Reasoned.description: A change to an idea, with why: it goes into the event or a note on the idea.

Registered.title: Registered
Registered.description: A campaign that registering added, read at ``cursor``, with its baseline candidate, which the daemon measures.

Relation.title: Relation
Relation.description: How a comment of ``Thread.linked`` relates to the root of the thread.

repeats.title: Repeats
repeats.description: How many pairs of the candidate and its bar.

RemeasureBody.title: RemeasureBody
RemeasureBody.description: How to measure a candidate again.

bar.title: Bar
bar.description: The bar that it is measured next to. Null: alone.

held.title: Held
held.description: What the daemon waits for before it measures, such as a resume. Null: it measures soon.

rejudged.title: Rejudged
rejudged.description: Whether the daemon judges the candidate again after the measurements. Else its verdict stays.

Remeasured.title: Remeasured
Remeasured.description: A candidate that the daemon measures again.

secret.description: The name of the home's secret that holds the credential, such as a token. None: the host asks for none.

Remote.title: Remote
Remote.description: A repository to clone, and the home's secret that its host asks for.

Rendered.title: Rendered
Rendered.description:
One section of what a reader sees: a title and its blocks (``piloop.plugins.section``).

A section provider returns it, the API answers it, and ``piloop status``, a brief and a UI render it.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, with ids: it goes into the ``campaign.reopened`` event.

ReopenBody.title: ReopenBody
ReopenBody.description: Why a stopped campaign is set active again.

Replied.title: Replied
Replied.description: The answer to an inbox item, read at ``cursor``.

ReplyBody.title: ReplyBody
ReplyBody.description: An answer to an inbox item: a ``decision`` on the root of its thread.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: Each metric's value, as the evaluate command's result would give it.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the evaluation failed. A failed measurement may lack metrics.

Report.title: Report
Report.description: A measurement made outside the daemon, for example by running the evaluate command by hand.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, with ids: it goes into a note on the campaign.

triggered.title: Triggered
triggered.description: Whether it has triggers: false, and the daemon launches its agents only on request (``piloop launch``).

requested.title: Requested
requested.description: Its agents that wait for a slot.

live.title: Live
live.description: Its agents that are starting or running: ``agents`` lists them.

last_ended.title: Last Ended
last_ended.description: When its latest agent ended, or null.

RoleView.title: RoleView
RoleView.description: A sweeping role of a campaign, as a console shows it: off, idle, starting or running.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: The table of the row: ``idea``, ``run``, ``candidate``, ``measurement`` or ``comment``.

id.title: Id
id.description: The row's id in its table.

label.title: Label
label.description: One line about the row, such as an idea's title.

RowLink.title: RowLink
RowLink.description: A row of piloop that a client opens from a node, with the API's route for its kind.

RunAnswer.title: RunAnswer
RunAnswer.description: A run that a change asked to cancel, read at ``cursor``.

RunningSince.title: RunningSince
RunningSince.description: An evaluation that has a slot of the executor.

name.title: Name
name.description: What a key of a node's ``scores`` says.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The metric that gives the score.

direction.description: Whether a higher or a lower score is better.

ScoreTrack.title: ScoreTrack
ScoreTrack.description: One axis of the scores: a node's score on it is the value of one metric.

SecretBody.title: SecretBody
SecretBody.description: The value of a secret, in place of any.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The name of the campaign whose secret it is. None: the home's.

SecretChanged.title: SecretChanged
SecretChanged.description: A secret that a change set or deleted, read at ``cursor``: never its value.

SecretList.title: SecretList
SecretList.description: The secrets, the home's first, by name.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The name of the campaign whose secret it is. None: the home's, for every campaign.

set_at.title: Set At
set_at.description: None for a value that piloop did not set: a provider elsewhere.

set_by.title: Set By
set_by.description: The actor that set it last.

SecretView.title: SecretView
SecretView.description: A secret of the home or of a campaign: who set it last and when, never its value.

Seed.title: Seed
Seed.description: A seed that waits for research.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.description: Pointers to what prompted the hunch: ids, paths or numbers.

base.title: Base
base.description: The candidate to start from, when the hunch is about that tree.

track.title: Track
track.description: The track it works on. Required when the campaign has more than one track.

SeedBody.title: SeedBody
SeedBody.description: A seed: a hunch with pointers, for research to develop into a defined idea or to reject.

SeedNews.title: SeedNews
SeedNews.description: A seed that someone else filed.

at.title: At
at.description: When it moved the spine forward.

SeriesPoint.title: SeriesPoint
SeriesPoint.description: A node that moved the spine forward, and when: a chart of the spine plots the node's scores at ``at``.

harness.title: Harness
harness.description: The ``[plugins.harness.<name>]`` that ran it. Null when its row has none.

session_id.title: Session Id
session_id.description: The harness's own session id. Null until piloop knows it (``agent_session.identified``).

SessionLink.title: SessionLink
SessionLink.description: An agent session that worked on a node, with the harness's own session id, so that a trace link is exact.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: What ``piloop status --json`` prints: the daemon, and each campaign read at ``cursor``.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for ``stopped_reason`` and the closing review.

ending.description: How the running implementers end. ``now`` also ends those of a stopped campaign that still wind down.

StoppedNews.title: StoppedNews
StoppedNews.description: A campaign that the daemon stopped.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description:
A ``TargetKind``: ``campaign``, ``idea``, ``run``, ``candidate``, ``measurement``, ``agent_session``, ``comment``, or
``home`` for an event about the whole home.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description:
The campaign of the row, resolved when the event is read. Null when the row is gone or has no campaign (a reply
to a reply). A campaign filter keeps these events too, because they may be of that campaign.

Subject.title: Subject
Subject.description: The row that an event is about.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Repo-relative path → why the sync did not read it (not UTF-8 text, unreadable, outside the repo).

Synced.title: Synced
Synced.description: What one sync of the campaign's documents did: the files that it added, those already in, those it skipped.

rows.title: Rows
rows.description: Each row has one value per column.

Target.title: Target
Target.description: The row that a comment is about.

Text.title: Text
Text.description: Markdown text: a paragraph, or a document with headings and tables of its own.

comment.description: The root of the thread: the comment itself, or the comment that its target is.

linked.title: Linked
linked.description: The replies, oldest first, then the other comments that cite the root or that it cites, oldest first.

Thread.title: Thread
Thread.description: The thread of a comment: its root, and the comments linked to the root. Each comment of it has the same thread.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the caller that uses it, such as a worker. No ``#``: that names a launched agent's token.

TokenBody.title: TokenBody
TokenBody.description: A bearer token to make for a caller.

TokenMade.title: TokenMade
TokenMade.description: A new token, with its secret: the only answer that carries it, since the home keeps its hash only.

TokenView.title: TokenView
TokenView.description: A bearer token of the server, never its secret.

Tone.title: Tone
Tone.description: How a client colours a status: the functional colour roles of GitHub's Primer design system.

TrackBody.title: TrackBody
TrackBody.description: The track to move an idea to.

TrackChanged.title: TrackChanged
TrackChanged.description: An idea that moved to another track.

metric.title: Metric
metric.description: The primary metric of the track.

value.title: Value
value.description: Null when the current evaluator has not measured the head.

delta.title: Delta
delta.description: Against the baseline. Null when the head is the baseline, or either is not measured.

Undelivered.title: Undelivered
Undelivered.description: The note never reached the agent: its runtime refused it, or the agent ended before it read it.

VerdictBody.title: VerdictBody
VerdictBody.description: A candidate's verdict, set by hand.

was.title: Was
was.description: The verdict that it had, as ``label`` reads it.

VerdictChanged.title: VerdictChanged
VerdictChanged.description: A candidate whose verdict was set by hand.

VerdictNews.title: VerdictNews
VerdictNews.description: The daemon's verdict on a measured candidate.

WaitingSince.title: WaitingSince
WaitingSince.description: An evaluation that waits for a slot, or a remeasure that someone asked for and that is not queued yet.
